changelog: - compatiblity with shaders Oculus and Continuity CTM textures.
- now the block is more dynamic supports even more logical blocks.
- now every block with menu is openable.
- 80% crash reduction, some of them werent related to me.
- now every block after each other without cutting any geo, so you can even use glass block as a frame.
- no texture fighting issues anymore or any other block rendering related problems.
- now double blocks are also placeable but both block needs to be multiblock first.
- some key event mechanics, now both pop and add is CTRL + M left and right, and fixed some logic bugs.
- animated blocks now animate and all collision issues are fixed.
- fixed some performance, like face culling and caching the models for future chunk builds.
- fixed some game functionalities, like fire, explosion, crops.
